name: Cleft lip with or without cleft palate

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical diagnosis of cleft lip with or without cleft palate

criteria.description: Visible unilateral or bilateral cleft of the upper lip
Presence or absence of cleft involving the hard and/or soft palate
Difficulty with feeding due to oronasal communication

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a visible cleft lip with or without cleft palate confirmed by clinical examination
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; imaging and genetic testing may support evaluation.
